name: dreamfactory/df-masking
description: Data Masking (column classification + response masking) and Compliance baselines for DreamFactory. Commercial (Gold).

suggest.dreamfactory/df-sqldb: Required for masking: SQL database services (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake) are the covered service types.
suggest.dreamfactory/df-compliance: Designates a root admin; only the root admin may loosen real-value access when one exists.
suggest.dreamfactory/df-limits: Rate limits, checked by the Compliance baselines.
suggest.dreamfactory/df-logger: Audit logging, checked by the Compliance baselines.
